title: Private deploy: cryptographic & access compliance sign-off checklist
creator: Ava Martinez
description: This ticket captures the final acceptance criteria, test plan, and sign-off checklist for Private deployment customers' security and compliance controls: enterprise SSO (SAML 2.0/OIDC), role-based access control mapping, audit/logging surface & retention, and KMS/HSM key custody and rotation requirements. The goal is to produce a deterministic checklist for Product, Security, Infrastructure, and Legal to sign off before shipping private-control-plane GA for regulated customers.
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML/OIDC: Customer can successfully configure SAML 2.0 IdP in the private control plane UI and perform an end-to-end login with assertions validated. Test accounts for SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows succeed.
User provisioning: SCIM provisioning can create/update/deactivate users and groups from IdP; group-to-role mappings in RBAC applied within 5 minutes of SCIM change.
RBAC: Predefined roles (admin, platform-operator, billing, read-only) enforce least-privilege across Console and API. Attempted unauthorized actions return 403 with audit event and request context.

KMS/HSM: Customer key import and key generation flows exist. Keys are never exported in plaintext. Envelope encryption with customer-managed keys (CMEK) is enforced for customer data; integration tests demonstrate decryption failure when key is disabled.
Key rotation: Automated rotation policy executes a rotation without breaking active workloads; a rollback key path exists and is validated in integration test.

Audit logs: Immutable audit trail for admin actions, key events, and auth events is produced with tamper-evident checksums. Retention policy configurable to 1/3/7 years. Sample queries for incident investigation return complete event context.
Operational telemetry: Token-level and request-level logs contain trace IDs, model variant, route, user principal, and cost estimate. PII is redacted according to privacy spec v1.2.
Failure modes: Fallback behavior documented and validated: when KMS is unreachable, requests fail closed for CMEK-protected data; an audit event and customer alert are generated.
Compliance evidence: Required artifacts (SAML metadata snapshot, RBAC matrix export, audit log sample, KMS key manifest) produced and attached to the release bundle.
Performance: Enabling audit-verbosity=high for private deployments increases CPU by no more than 8% and median API latency by <20ms in acceptance test harness (95th percentile within SLA).
scope_changes: IN: SAML 2.0 with optional OIDC support for SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; SCIM v2 supported for provisioning.
IN: CMEK for all customer-sensitive datastore blobs used by the control plane (configs, tokens, audit indexes).

OUT: Full HSM appliance on customer premises (deferred to post-GA professional services).
Note: HSM-as-a-service integration via partner HSM providers is included for GA.

CLARIFIED: Audit retention UI will expose presets (1y/3y/7y) and allow custom retention via API. Long-term archival export to customer S3 is supported but lifecycle policies for egress billing are separate work.

test_plan: Automated e2e test: deploy private control plane in staging with a test IdP (Okta) and run SAML SP-initiated & IdP-initiated login flows. Assert user attributes and groups translated to RBAC roles.
SCIM test: Update group membership in IdP and assert SCIM events reflect within 3 polling cycles and role change enforcement in Console.
KMS test: Import a customer key, encrypt a control-plane secret, disable the key and assert decrypt fails, re-enable and assert restore succeeds. Verify audit events for each operation.
Key rotation test: Run scheduled rotation job against a live key in staging, ensure in-flight tokens continue to validate and no data corruption occurs.
Audit sampling: Generate scripted admin actions and verify entries exist for UI/API, include request IDs, actor, and pre/post state where applicable.
Privacy: Run PII redaction validator on logs to ensure no email addresses, API keys, or model outputs are present in cleartext in audit indices.
Performance baseline: Run 30-minute load test with audit-verbosity=high and compare latency/cpu to baseline; record diffs and confirm acceptance thresholds.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Canary - internal): Deploy to dedicated staging cluster; invite internal SRE and selected early access customers for validation (2 weeks).
Phase 1 (Pilot - paid customers): Onboard 3 pilot customers with compliance requirements; run 1:1 onboarding sessions and collect feedback (4 weeks).
Phase 2 (Gradual GA): Enable private control plane in 10% of new private tenants with feature gate; monitor SSO failure rate, KMS error rate, and RBAC denial trends for 2 weeks.
Full GA: Roll to all new private deployments after thresholds met; provide opt-in migration path for existing private customers with a migration runbook.
Rollback: If KMS outage leads to >1% failed requests or SSO errors exceed 5% for 6 hours, automatically disable CMEK and run incident response (requires infra+sec signoff to re-enable).
decisions: Chose SAML 2.0 as primary enterprise protocol with optional OIDC because majority of pilot customers require SAML metadata exchange and attribute mappings.
Adopted envelope encryption with customer-managed keys instead of giving customers raw key material access; HSM-based key import limited to remote HSM providers for GA.
RBAC will be role-based with group sync; fine-grained policy language deferred to Phase 2 due to scope and UX complexity.
risks_mitigation: Risk: Misconfigured SAML mappings could lock customers out. Mitigation: Provide a test-account flow and a safe-mode admin bypass token for emergency support with audit triggers.
Risk: KMS latency causes request failures. Mitigation: Cache short-lived DEKs (data encryption keys) and implement exponential backoff with circuit breaker; monitor with alerts.
Risk: Audit store growth and cost. Mitigation: Offer retention presets and automatic archival to customer-owned storage with lifecycle policies.
